description: Bounded deterministic replay of CL complementary-pair bucket scoring with h=10.

source.title: Selecting Complementary Pairs of Literals
source.reference: Algorithm CL and Definitions 1-2, Electronic Notes in Discrete Mathematics 16 (2003), pp. 47-70, DOI 10.1016/S1571-0653(04)00462-7
source.flow_reference: The Probabilistic Analysis of a Greedy Satisfiability Algorithm, Section 5, DOI 10.1002/rsa.20104
source.chapter: Thresholds of Random k-SAT, Encyclopedia of Algorithms, Chapter 423, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4939-2864-4_423
source.implementation_status: bounded deterministic clean-room trace; supplied formula; no probability or threshold claim

input.encoding: [n,m,(k,l1,l2,l3)*m] with zero padding after the k literals
input.clause_rule: Each clause has size 1..3; its first k signed one-based literals are in range and use distinct variables; later slots are zero. Repeated clauses are permitted.

contract.bucket: An unset literal tau is in X(i,j), 0<=i,j<=10, where i=min(10,occurrence_degree(tau)) and j=min(10,occurrence_degree(not tau)). Both signs of each unset variable are bucketed.
contract.flow_rates: For residual formula F, m2 is the average d2(-tau) and m3 is the average d3(-tau) over literal occurrences tau in 2-clauses; dK counts occurrences in exactly K-clauses. Both rates are zero when there are no 2-clause occurrences.
contract.bucket_trial: For each nonempty X(i,j), set its lowest-variable-ID literal true (positive sign before negative on a same-variable tie), then set the first residual unit clause in formula order true until none remain. A trial producing an empty clause is ineligible.
contract.selection: Compute exact rational R=(m2_after-m2_before)/(m3_after-m3_before). Trials with zero denominator are ineligible. Choose maximum R, breaking ties by lowest (i,j). If no trial is eligible, stop with status 2.
contract.outer_trace: Propagate initial unit clauses first. Then repeatedly select the chosen bucket's same lowest-ID literal, apply Davis-Putnam delete-and-shrink, and propagate first-in-formula-order units. Stop on an empty clause or when all variables are assigned.
contract.output: [status,n,assigned_count,assignment[n],trace_count,(literal,kind,bucket_i,bucket_j)*trace_count]. Status 0 means complete without contradiction; 1 means this no-backtrack trace generated an empty clause; 2 means no bucket has a defined score. Assignment is 1, -1, or 0 while unset. kind 0 is a free choice; kind 1 is a forced unit with bucket indices -1,-1.

workspace.meaning: Bounded residual formula, trial copies, degree/flow counters, assignments, bucket choice, trace, and staged output.
